source: Local official SEC companyfacts bulk archive plus manually audited historical ticker identity intervals
identity_policy: Ticker-to-CIK intervals are non-overlapping; Disney uses predecessor and successor registrant CIKs around the 2019 reorganization.
sector_policy: Static broad business-category proxy compatible with the existing SEC SIC buckets; it is not a dated SEC SIC history.
known_limitations: Historical issuer mapping was manually audited against local companyfacts entity names rather than downloaded from a canonical security-master feed.
Broad sector labels are static and therefore must not be described as point-in-time SEC SIC classifications.
BAC CIK 70858 currently identifies BofA Finance LLC in the bulk archive and requires filing-level coverage validation.
